newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares seen weak in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares seen weak in slow trading.

text.p: Jakarta share prices are seen weak in slow trading on Wednesday, brokers said.

"Local sentiment is likely to stay weak after sharp falls the past two days, but Wall Street's rise overnight is likely to limit any possible sharp slide," one broker with a foreign brokerage firm said.
The broker said he also expected local speculative buying in some second-liners to limit any possible sharp fall.
Brokers said tin mining firm Tambang Timah was likely to remain among the market focus after its sharp falls the past two days.
He said players had previously bought Timah as it was expected to be able to get up to a 20-percent stake in the huge Busang gold project in Kalimantan, but it now seems uncertain.
The Jakarta composite index closed 6.55 points lower at 695.22 points on Tuesday.
